Munger University UG 2nd Merit List 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Munger University, Bihar, has released the merit list for the Undergraduate (UG)/ Graduation/ Degree Course (B.A/ B.Sc/ B.Com) For Academic Session 2026-30 for 4 year programme under Choice Based Credit System (CBCS). The applications for Munger University UG Admissions Online Form 2026 were accepted from 29 April 2026 to 12 May 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their Munger University UG 2nd Merit List 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 29 April 2026
  • Last Date : 12 May 2026
  • 1st Merit List : 13 June 2026
  • 2nd Merit List : 24 June 2026
  • Admission : 24 -30 June 2026

Application Fee

  • All Candidates : Rs. 1000/-
  • Pay the Examination Fee Through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, E Challan, E Wallet, Cash Card Fee Mode Only.
